status: COMPLETE. NEGATIVE RESULT, CLEANLY MEASURED. Seven scored 38-request arms on one host, one probe, pre-registered thresholds. DO NOT ENABLE LMCACHE.
headline: The gate patch did NOT reach 0/38 and must not be shipped as a fix. It made things far worse, for the reason its own author flagged as untested. UNPATCHED, this host reproduces the 5090 baseline EXACTLY - L1cold 7/38 and L2warm 7/38, same failing-request geometry, same predictive rule 7/7 with zero false positives - on a different model edition, different GPU, different driver, TP2 instead of TP1, docker instead of podman. Applying the fork's #403 divergent-hit gate takes those arms to 37/38 and 38/38, and both restart arms to 38/38, because closing the scheduler-side path is what finally makes LMCache SUPPLY tokens (vLLM external_prefix_cache_hits_total delta 0 -> 59,200/60,800/76,800), and the LMCache MP retrieve path does not restore hybrid GDN state either. The gate is necessary and insufficient: it converts a bounded, silent, 18-percent-of-requests defect into total U+FFFD token soup with SpecDecoding acceptance median 0.0 on every request. receipts/lmcache-fix.json listed 'whether LMCache retrieves restore hybrid GDN state correctly when they DO supply tokens (ext > 0)' as an open LMCache-side question. Measured answer: they do not.

verdict.recommendation: DO NOT ENABLE LMCache on this stack, with or without the gate patch. Keep it in the image, keep it disabled by default, exactly as receipts/tb21-image-sr1.json patch_layers[D] already has it.
verdict.gate_patch_disposition: local-inference-lab/vllm#403 stays OPEN and correct as a scheduler-correctness fix (it removes an unconditional wrong-contract path), but it is NOT a corruption fix for LMCache and its PR body's prediction of 0/38 is now REFUTED by measurement. It must be re-labelled before anyone reads it as a green light.
verdict.remaining_defect_named: LMCacheMPConnector's retrieve path (lmcache_driven_transfer, multi_layer_block_kv_transfer mode 'ptr') restores full-attention KV for the chunks it supplies but does not restore the lagging recurrent (Mamba/GDN) state at the resume boundary either. With the scheduler gate in place, EVERY request with a nonzero external hit resumes from an uninitialised/stale GDN state, which is why the divergence-window rule stops applying and the failure becomes total instead of bounded. Fixing this requires LMCache to store and restore the SSM/GDN state block alongside the attention KV (what nixl's _apply_prefix_caching does unconditionally), or to declare itself unable to and refuse hybrid models - neither exists in 0.5.2+glm52dcp.4.
verdict.l1_dram_shippability: NOT SHIPPABLE for correctness reasons, not capacity or performance reasons. The L1 CPU-DRAM tier itself worked mechanically and its economics are excellent (26.5x/53.2x TTFT reduction, 92.6%/97.6% hit rate). Every one of those warm responses that the detector examined was corrupted. Speed that returns wrong tokens is not a feature.
verdict.second_finding_the_gate_is_blind: tools/tb21_gate.py returned verdict PASS on ALL FIVE checks - liveness, generation, repeatability, the full 262,144-token needle, and MTP - against the same live server on which the probe measured 38/38 corrupted. The five-check gate cannot see this defect class, because none of its checks reuses a prefix across a mamba block boundary. Nobody may infer LMCache fidelity from a gate PASS. receipt: receipts/tb21-gate-2x-lmcache-l1.json

forced_profile_finding_lmcache_costs_pre.what: The shipping 2x profile CANNOT run LMCache on this model at all. With --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 the image's own connector refuses to initialise, in both TP workers, before serving anything.
forced_profile_finding_lmcache_costs_pre.error_verbatim: ValueError: Mamba-hybrid models with LMCache require block_size <= max_num_batched_tokens < 2 * block_size so every prefill step advances exactly one block and every block boundary gets a state snapshot; got max_num_batched_tokens=8192, block_size=1600. Set --max-num-batched-tokens 1600.
forced_profile_finding_lmcache_costs_pre.what_we_used: 2048, inside the band and identical to the 5090 pre-registration, so this forced change REMOVES a deviation instead of adding one. Every arm including L0 ran at 2048.
forced_profile_finding_lmcache_costs_pre.why_it_matters_for_shipping: enabling LMCache on a hybrid model forces max_num_batched_tokens from 8192 down to at most 3199, a 2.6x reduction in prefill chunk size, before any correctness question is asked. Even a hypothetical fixed LMCache would carry this cost on this model.
forced_profile_finding_lmcache_costs_pre.evidence: out/lmcache-batched8192-rejection.txt and logs/server-U1U2-rejected-8192.log on the host; the ValueError line is reproduced above verbatim
forced_profile_finding_lmcache_costs_pre.note: this guard is the same 'every block boundary gets a state snapshot' invariant the root cause is about - the code knows the invariant exists and enforces it for prefill chunking, while the retrieve path violates it.

collides_with_our_largest_measured_prefi.the_collision: docs/47 F8 measures +13-15 % on the linears from moving the prefill chunk 2048 -> 6144, and F5 item 1 adds 2.67x less redundant reconstruct at the same chunk; docs/47's recoverable table row 7 calls --max-num-batched-tokens 6144 the single largest prefill lever available, est. +15-25 % PP. 6144 is OUTSIDE LMCache's admissible band [1600, 3199]. LMCache and that lever are therefore MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE on this model - an admissibility conflict, not a tuning tension: the connector refuses to initialise above 3199.
collides_with_our_largest_measured_prefi.what_this_does_to_the_decision: the trade is not 'corruption risk versus a 53x TTFT prize'. It is corruption risk, PLUS a 2.6x prefill-chunk cut, PLUS forfeiting a measured +13-15 % (est. +15-25 % PP), in exchange for a 53x TTFT prize that returns U+FFFD. Every term except the prize is a cost and the prize is unusable.

the_preregistered_predictive_rule_reprod.rule: a request fails iff a SCORED needle lies inside [hit_tokens - 1600, hit_tokens), the divergence window between the full-attention group's hit and the last position with a recurrent-state checkpoint
the_preregistered_predictive_rule_reprod.how_scored: needle absolute offset = prompts.head_tokens (35) + needle.token_end, both frozen properties of prompts_sha256 9978404b; hit_tokens is vLLM's own per-request prefix_cache_hits counter delta. Neither quantity is fitted to the outcome.
the_preregistered_predictive_rule_reprod.reading: UNPATCHED U1cold and U2warm: the rule predicts 7 failures and gets exactly those 7, zero false positives and zero false negatives, in both arms - the same 7/38 count and the same divergence-window mechanism the 5090 measured. L0: the identical rule, applied to L0's own recorded hits, flags 7 requests and NONE of them fails - the connector-absent control at identical reuse geometry, 7/7 correct, discriminating scheduler-side state loss from any data-delivery story.
the_preregistered_predictive_rule_reprod.hit_reconciliation_reading: every one of the 76 unpatched LMCache-arm rows reconciles as hit_arm == hit_L0 + 1600, or both zero for the first-ever request, or a full self-match at the request's own full-chunk cap in the warm pass - the same 76/76 reconciliation receipts/lmcache-fix.json reported for the 5090, reproduced row for row on different hardware.
the_preregistered_predictive_rule_reprod.the_rule_stops_applying_once_the_gate_is: with the gate the failure is no longer bounded by the divergence window: 37/38 and 38/38 fail, including requests with no scored needle anywhere near a boundary. That is the signature of a different mechanism, and it is the one the ext>0 retrieve path introduces.

the_causal_chain_quantified.instrument: vLLM's own external_prefix_cache_{hits,queries}_total, deltas between the named per-arm pre/post /metrics snapshots (never absolutes), corroborated by counted 'Stored'/'Retrieved' lines in the LMCache MP server log

unpatched.reading: LMCache was asked 88,760 tokens' worth of questions across the two arms and supplied ZERO tokens. It never retrieved once. The 7/38 corruption in these arms is therefore 100 % scheduler-side, which confirms receipts/lmcache-fix.json's correction of our earlier upstream comments: the bounded failures are not wrong bytes from LMCache.

gate_patched.reading: the gate removes the scheduler's wrong-contract shortcut, so vLLM now actually loads from the connector - ext > 0 for the first time in this entire investigation - and the corruption becomes total. The gate did not create a new bug; it revealed the one receipts/lmcache-fix.json named as untested.

chosen_logprob_divergence_vs_L0.instrument: mean |chosen-token logprob delta| against the L0 control, per arm, same instrument as the 5090 run
chosen_logprob_divergence_vs_L0.reading: 0.238/0.242 reproduces the 5090's measured ~0.245 almost exactly - independent agreement of a second instrument across two platforms. The patched arms are 18x worse: not a boundary defect, a destroyed state. identical_text_requests is 0 in all six LMCache arms, so every request with any hit ran with a divergent state even when its answers survived.

counter_sanity_check.what: vLLM's prefix_cache_queries_total delta divided by the frozen schedule's own total prompt length (301,180 tokens over 38 requests), per arm
counter_sanity_check.reading: the instrument is exact (1.00x) in every arm that is not in the total-corruption regime, which is why the hit deltas above can be read literally. The L3 arms' 9.99x and 1.61x are the same counter inflation receipts/lmcache-reuse-test.json flagged on its own L3restart rows ('a counter artifact under async loads, noted, not load-bearing'): under total corruption the engine re-queries. Reproduced here, still not load-bearing - the arm counts are scored from response text, not counters.

L3restart_over_FRESH_L2.l2_at_pass_start: 596 files, 47,535,357,952 bytes - written by the GATE-PATCHED cold/warm passes and retained
L3restart_over_FRESH_L2.outcome: REFUTED. 38/38 failed, all four detectors' out_of_script and replacement-char firing on every request, acceptance median 0.0.
L3restart_over_FRESH_L2.why_the_expectation_was_wrong: the expectation assumed the patched arms would produce poison-free stores. They do not: the patched cold/warm passes were themselves 37/38 and 38/38 corrupt, so the 'fresh' L2 is a store of KV computed under a corrupted boundary state. A poison-free L2 is unreachable on this stack, because there is no configuration in which the writer is clean.

L3restart_over_POISONED_L2.l2_at_pass_start: 34 files, 2,711,748,608 bytes - the retained copy written by the UNPATCHED arms
L3restart_over_POISONED_L2.outcome: CONFIRMED. 38/38 failed. Retrieval activity is real: 26 files and 2.07 GB were added during the pass and vLLM recorded a 76,800-token external hit delta, so the poisoned stores were genuinely re-served.

the_two_L3restart_variants_reported_sepa.honest_limit_on_this_comparison: both variants are 38/38, so this pair confirms the poisoned-stays-dirty prediction but CANNOT isolate poison propagation from the ext>0 retrieve defect: with the gate applied both mechanisms are active at once. Isolating them needs an LMCache that restores hybrid state, which does not exist yet.

The /status endpoint on 8330 worked and is what the L1 numbers below come from.

what_an_api_host_would_ask_for_hit_rate_.method: the project's existing reuse method (probe reuse mode): two disjoint documents no correctness arm touched, at 32k and 128k, each issued cold then warm then warm-exact on the SAME live gate-patched LMCache server, with prefix-cache hits and queries read as DELTAS between the named per-request /metrics snapshots, never as absolutes. Arm-level snapshots: reuse-L1-pre and reuse-L1-post.
what_an_api_host_would_ask_for_hit_rate_.reading: the economics are exactly what makes this feature attractive and exactly why the negative result matters. 32k: TTFT 6.3234 s cold -> 0.2387 s warm, 6.0847 s saved, 26.5x, hit rate 0.9256. 128k: 32.5141 s -> 0.6111 s, 31.903 s saved, 53.2x, hit rate 0.9760. THEN: the corruption detector fired on 3 of the 4 warm variants (32k warm, 32k warm-exact, 128k warm-exact). A 53x prefill win that returns U+FFFD is not a win, and an API host shipping it would serve silent HTTP 200 garbage to every cache-hitting request.
what_an_api_host_would_ask_for_hit_rate_.note_on_the_cold_32k_query_delta: the 32k cold row's prefix_cache_queries delta is 65,684, EXACTLY twice its 32,842-token prompt, so that one request was counted twice by the queries counter; its hits delta is 0 either way, so the cold hit rate of 0.0 and the TTFT of 6.3234 s are unaffected. Mechanism uninstrumented, named not explained. The warm and warm-exact rows are clean single-request deltas (32,842 queries, 30,400 hits each) and the 0.9256 hit rate quoted is theirs.

five_check_fidelity_gate_on_the_lmcache_.tool: tools/tb21_gate.py, run from the driver VM ubuntu@151.185.34.98 against --base-url http://10.0.0.4:8000 while the gate-patched LMCache server was held up
five_check_fidelity_gate_on_the_lmcache_.needle_included: yes - check 4 needle_retrieval at the full 262,144-token window, PASS
five_check_fidelity_gate_on_the_lmcache_.what_this_does_and_does_not_mean: It means the server is alive, generates, is repeatable within the process, retrieves a needle from a 262k context and drafts with MTP. It does NOT mean fidelity: the probe measured 38/38 corrupted on this same server minutes earlier. The gate's needle is a single long request with no prefix reuse, so no check crosses a mamba block boundary of a cached prefix. Treat a gate PASS as necessary and nowhere near sufficient whenever a KV connector is attached.
five_check_fidelity_gate_on_the_lmcache_.action_item_this_creates: SUPERSEDED - the check was built and validated, see sixth_gate_check_built_and_validated below.

unproven_until_gpu_ladder_closed_out.item_1_gate_turns_L1cold_L2warm_to_0_of_: REFUTED. 37/38 and 38/38. The prediction was wrong because it assumed the scheduler path was the only defect.
unproven_until_gpu_ladder_closed_out.item_2_L3_over_fresh_L2_clean_and_over_p: HALF CONFIRMED. Poisoned L2 stayed dirty (38/38) as predicted. Fresh L2 was NOT clean (38/38): a poison-free L2 cannot be produced on this stack because every writer configuration is itself corrupt.
unproven_until_gpu_ladder_closed_out.item_3_p1s1_zero_hit_L3restart_failure: DID NOT RECUR in this form. p1s1 is the only request that PASSED in the patched L1cold arm (it is the first-ever request and can retrieve nothing), and it failed in both restart arms with a nonzero hit. The 5090's zero-hit-and-still-wrong anomaly did not reproduce; with the gate applied there is no longer a bounded regime in which it could be isolated. Still uninstrumented, still a named blind spot.
unproven_until_gpu_ladder_closed_out.item_4_PR_4600_behavioural_effect: PARTIALLY ANSWERED, negatively. The deployed wheel already carries the equivalent fail-closed guard (vLLM shows kv_load_failure_policy='fail'), so all six LMCache arms ran WITH that contract in place, and it prevented none of this. Its CPU-proven contract stands; it is not a corruption fix either.

not_claimed: that LMCache is unusable for non-hybrid (pure full-attention) models - nothing here tests that, and the defect mechanism is specifically about the lagging recurrent state of a hybrid model
that a corrected LMCache could not deliver these TTFT wins - the 26.5x/53.2x figures show the prize is real; only this implementation's correctness is refuted
that the gate patch is wrong as scheduler code - it removes a genuinely unconditional wrong-contract path and its CPU gates stand; it is simply not sufficient, and its 0/38 prediction is refuted

cross-host comparability - every number here is from one host, one image, one probe. The 5090 comparison is legitimate only because the probe, prompts, thresholds, fail rule and 1600-token block geometry are identical; the model edition and parallelism are not, which is exactly why the unpatched arm pair was run
that 160 GiB is the optimal L1 size - it was never the binding constraint at this workload (27.7 % peak use)

sixth_gate_check_built_and_validated.policy: OFF by default so every previously published gate receipt stays comparable; MANDATORY whenever the server runs with --kv-transfer-config, i.e. any KV connector attached. Ruling by Main, 2026-08-17.
sixth_gate_check_built_and_validated.what_it_does: request A at 4B+500 tokens publishes cache blocks and is its own control (it reuses nothing); request B at 4B+900 over the SAME document reuses a >4B prefix and is scored on two needles - N1 far from any boundary, which must survive, and N2 placed inside [3B, 4B), the LAST block of B's hit, i.e. exactly the divergence window between the full-attention group's hit and the last recurrent-state checkpoint. Losing N2 while keeping N1 is the hybrid+connector signature; losing both is total state loss.
sixth_gate_check_built_and_validated.needle_placement_is_measured_not_assumed: needle depths and both document lengths are re-measured through the endpoint's own /tokenize, and the receipt records whether N2 actually landed inside [3B, 4B). Measured here: N2 at token depth 6192 inside [4800, 6400).
sixth_gate_check_built_and_validated.never_reports_a_vacuous_pass: status is NOT_EXERCISED, never PASS, if request B reused fewer than one block; the receipt gained a not_exercised_checks list and a verdict_scope string so a PASS can no longer be read as a fidelity claim
